module_review.evidence_and_location: Retained surveyed office shell/services are baseline; actual Cat A raised-floor/ceiling/basic finishes and electrical/lighting/HVAC/wet/fire systems have SKU/native quantities and upstream package boundaries, not a mandatory typical recipe.

module_review.evidence_and_location: Actual contracted interface points, coordinated system tests, drawings/O&M, closed defects and landlord acceptance establish Cat A base state, not tenant Cat B occupation readiness.

module_review.question: identify joining service roles without inventing performance values
module_review.evidence_and_location: Installation, actual service/common-core upgrades, temporary utilities/access and commissioning provider resources are causally attributed once to the accepted office footprint with full upstream scope.

module_review.question: distinguish rejected assemblies and losses from intended output
module_review.evidence_and_location: Rejects return to producing installation/test responsibility; actual matched returns/waste are recorded, and overlapping floor/ceiling/trade tests never inflate A.

module_review.question: identify the source or capture context
module_review.evidence_and_location: Actual occupied/phased office survey/hazards and retained-replaced schedule define the old fabric/services; no historic whole-building repurchase.

module_review.question: identify the removed-material output state and hand-off
module_review.evidence_and_location: Independent stripout/isolation responsibility passes qualified retained substrate/service interface to integration and reusable historic or controlled waste materials to actual receivers.

module_review.question: distinguish residuals and losses from intended outputs
module_review.evidence_and_location: Retained elements, removed reuse, contained contaminated waste and actual substance-medium releases remain distinct; a hazard label supplies no emitted mass.

module_review.question: explain why removal is independent of adjacent treatment or production
module_review.evidence_and_location: Independent removal is justified by actual isolation, source/receiver and retained-substrate release records, not demolition keywords alone.

module_review.question: enumerate relevant periods and phases
module_review.evidence_and_location: Survey/isolation/stripout, phased installation and tests/retests precede section/final acceptance; shared assets still span all-consumer full life.

module_review.question: link inputs, assets, outputs, and events to periods
module_review.evidence_and_location: Office-zone/polygon/job/event/phase/period IDs join stocks, temporary utilities, providers/assets and accepted area.

module_review.question: record period-specific attribution decisions
module_review.evidence_and_location: Actual attributed shared core/system upgrades stay in construction numerator; later tenant fitout, occupation energy or future savings are separate.

module_review.question: prevent double attribution
module_review.evidence_and_location: Unique surveyed accepted net internal office polygons count once; associated common areas and trade/ceiling/floor overlap do not multiply A or shared burdens.

module_review.question: identify the rejected or off-spec state

module_review.question: declare whether material is reworked, downgraded, recovered, or discarded

module_review.question: link rework loops and boundary exits to the producing node

module_review.question: prevent rejected material from being counted as an accepted output
module_review.evidence_and_location: Only unique complete accepted office A is denominator; repeat tests/partial unaccepted polygons and tenant occupation claims cannot add output or credits.

module_review.question: identify the shared asset or service
module_review.evidence_and_location: Actual access/lifting/test and temporary service infrastructure have named provider/direct/rental ownership and whole-life coverage.

module_review.question: enumerate every consuming node and relevant period
